sections.title: Sound of letter o
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (o) /o/. Its main sound is a vowel, which means a sound made with open air. You hear it in (olive) /ɔ.liv/. The letter makes two sounds in total.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, drop your jaw slightly. Pull your tongue back and make an oval shape with your lips. For the second sound, raise your tongue a little higher. Push your lips forward into a small tight circle. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: You make the first sound in most closed beats or before one consonant, as in (porte) /pɔʁt/. You make the second sound at the end of a beat, as in (vélo) /ve.lo/. It also appears before a z sound, as in (rose) /ʁoz/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn either sound into a diphthong, which means two vowel sounds gliding together. The English vowel in go glides at the end. Keep your lips completely still until the sound stops.
